Lady Ardylia!
It seems...
that's indeed the case.
Anyway, let's hurry!
Well then,
shall we go?
This is... the place
where Kyuuma and Lady Misumi
were arguing before...
This is... the place
where Kyuuma and Lady Misumi
were arguing before...
The shrine here
was built to serve
as Lord Rikuto's tomb.
I wished him to witness
my passing on to you
the story he told me.
...
First... I should explain
why I knew
about the sword.
Yes. I'd like to hear it.
Please tell me.
It's simple.
That sword was first
used during
the war on this island...
What!?
You could say
Shartos, the Azure Sage Emperor,
was born on this island.
At the very least,
it was here that it gained
the ability to wield its present power.
Wait a minute!
Please,
wait a minute!
But Yard said the ones
who created this sword were
the founders of the Colorless Faction...
But Yard said the ones
who created this sword were
the founders of the Colorless Faction...
You don't mean...!?
That is correct...
The same organization of summoners
created this island
and that sword.
The Colorless Faction.
Wh...
Huh...
Most of those
who knew that truth
are no longer alive.
So many lives
were lost
in the war long ago...
...
It is said the summoners fought
among themselves and perished,
but that is only part of the truth.
The true cause of the war
was a summoner's rebellion
against the faction.
Could that have been
the person you mentioned before...?
Indeed...
An outcast within the faction.
A summoner who dreamed
of making this island a paradise.
He was also
a dear friend of my lord,
Lord Rikuto.
!
To help him,
Lord Rikuto led us
into battle...
So...
